problem:
A series RCL circuit has a source electromotive force (EMF) of $12\,\text{V},$ a resistor of resistance $9\,Ω,$ a capacitor of capacitance $0.5\,\text{F},$ and an inductor of inductance $4\,\text{H}.$ Find, in amperes, the amount of current in the circuit after $0.4$ seconds, given that the initial charge on the capacitor is $1\,\text{C}$ and the initial current is $2\,\text{A}.$

*Hint: The voltage drop ${V}_{C}$ across the capacitor is related to its charge by $q=C{V}_{C},$ where $C$ is the capacitance measured in Farads.*

activity_context.topic_title: Modeling Current in RCL Circuits With Second-Order ODEs
